title: Quantum Meta-Complexity Is All You Need: Characterizing One-Way Puzzles via Time-Bounded Kolmogorov Complexity
summary: We initiate the time-bounded meta-complexity program for quantum cryptography. Recent work characterizes one-way puzzles, the minimal search primitive of quantum cryptography without one-way functions, by the average-case hardness of approximating the plain, uncomputable Kolmogorov complexity over quantumly samplable distributions; the classical program of Liu and Pass, by contrast, lives at polynomial time bounds.
